publication.title: On Faceted Search over Knowledge Bases
publication.frozen_record_title: On faceted search over knowledge bases

source_reading.scope: Motivation; Technical Approach; Faceted Interfaces/Queries; Interface Generation and Update

adjudication.basis: Primary formal method for user facet/path refinement and ontology-guided update over RDF/OWL instance knowledge, with prototype implementation reported.

backend.source_model_description: RDF/SPARQL1.1 and OWL2profile reasoning; positive-existential tree-shaped faceted query fragment; prototype cited separately.

descriptions.interaction: Conjunctive/disjunctive facets, nested relation paths, branching and refocusing; tick/untick values to refine results and available choices.
descriptions.guidance: Initial interface and subsequent choices justified by ontology entailments; update algorithms offer semantically meaningful refinements.
descriptions.visualisation: Faceted interfaces formalized; Figure1 is explanatory annotated-data diagram, not evidence of an implemented node-link UI.
descriptions.backend: RDF/SPARQL1.1 and OWL2profile reasoning; positive-existential tree-shaped faceted query fragment; prototype cited separately.
descriptions.evaluation: Formal expressivity/complexity analysis with YAGO president example; prototype tests cited without results in this extended abstract.

report_level_evaluation.design: Formal expressivity/complexity analysis with YAGO president example; prototype tests cited without results in this extended abstract.
report_level_evaluation.results: Combined query complexity PTIME-complete for RL/EL and NP-complete for QL; active-domain semantics tractable for all profiles. These are formal results, not measured latency/usability benefits.; limits: No recruited sample, explicit user-task experiment or numeric computational benchmark in this report; exact prototype name/code not established.
